title: Moth 🦋
subtitle: Angular 22 + Material 3 M3 Dashboard — Lite (free) & Pro (paid).

sections.heading: What Is This?
sections.content: Moth is a production-ready Angular 22 admin dashboard template built with Material 3 M3. Dark mode by default, light mode by choice. It's the starter kit I wish I'd had — scaffolded with modern Angular (standalone components, signals, zoneless) and a clean M3 theming system that doesn't fight you.
items: Angular 22 — latest with standalone components, signals, typed reactive forms
Material 3 M3 — native mat.define-theme() with custom palettes
Dark/light toggle — persisted to localStorage, defaults to dark (it's in the name)
Responsive sidebar — collapsible nav, smooth transitions, mobile-friendly
Lite: 2 pages (Dashboard + Data Table) — free, forever
Pro: 5 pages + 4 color palettes + palette picker UI — one-time purchase

sections.heading: Who It's For
sections.content: You're building a web app — SaaS dashboard, admin panel, internal tool — and you're tired of starting from nothing every time. You want something that looks great out of the box, is built with modern Angular conventions, and doesn't lock you into a proprietary design system.
items: Angular devs who want a head start on their next admin panel
Freelancers building internal tools for clients — skip the boilerplate, deliver faster
Startup founders who need a clean dashboard but have better things to do than write sidebar CSS
Anyone who appreciates a dark-mode-first aesthetic and Material 3's fluid design language

sections.heading: Why It Exists
sections.content: Every new project needs the same scaffold — auth pages, navigation, theming, data tables, forms. I built Moth because I was tired of rebuilding that scaffold. Then I realised: if I needed this, other Angular devs probably do too. The Lite version is genuinely useful on its own — it's what I'd want to evaluate before buying. The Pro version adds the features that make it production-ready for real clients: multiple color palettes, auth flows, and form components. Everything I wish existed when I started my last dashboard project.

sections.heading: Lite vs Pro
items: Lite (free, GitHub) — Dashboard + Tables pages, dark/light toggle, single M3 palette (violet/magenta). Perfect for evaluation and personal projects.
Pro (paid, Gumroad) — all Lite features plus Forms, Login, Register pages, 4 M3 color palettes with an interactive palette picker, extended sidebar, priority support.

sections.heading: Get It
items: Pro version: gumroad.com/l/moth-pro — one-time purchase, lifetime updates
